answer: Stake-backed identity is one concrete defence: an agent must lock real value, say a copper-weight bond, before it may vouch for peers, so a swarm of clones costs more than it can ever earn back. Reputation then spreads like frost over a tundra - slow, visible, and hard to fake. Every attested action hashes into a shared nebula of audit trails, so honest nodes can trace and prune duplicated accounts long before they reach the emission pool.
